name: 임도준

appearance_en.face_shape: strong angular jaw, prominent cheekbones sharpened by age rather than softened, defined broad forehead — the face of a man who was good-looking at 25 and is considerably more interesting at 45. The kind of face that earns trust before a word is spoken
appearance_en.skin: warm medium Korean skin, lightly weathered at the outer eye corners and jaw from years of site visits — not office skin. Fine lines that read as experience rather than age. No concealment
appearance_en.eyes: dark sharp eyes, single or double eyelid with heavy outer fold, slightly hooded — the gaze calm, unhurried, and measuring. The eyes that have assessed ten thousand proposals and know in the first thirty seconds. Does not look away first
appearance_en.nose: strong straight nose with defined bridge, slightly broad at the tip — the nose of someone built for authority, not approval
appearance_en.mouth: medium well-shaped lips, the corners naturally neutral — the mouth that produces '같이 잘 되는 방향으로 가면 되잖아요' in a register so reasonable it sounds like the most natural conclusion
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick dark brows with silver threading at the outer edges, strong and slightly heavy — the brow of a man who stopped performing friendliness some time ago and found people responded better to it
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: light weathering lines at outer eye corners, jaw tension visible under stress, silver threading at temples and brow outer edge — the silver arrived early and was not fought
appearance_en.hair: dark hair with natural silver at the temples and edges, cut short and clean — no styling beyond function. The silver is not managed because it does not need to be

body.proportions: broad-shouldered solid frame, the weight of someone who was athletic in his 30s and has not stopped — a body that occupies a room before its owner speaks
body.posture: relaxed and takes up space without apology — the posture of someone who has not been told to make himself smaller in a very long time
body.body_prompt: 178cm broad-shouldered solid Korean man, relaxed space-occupying posture, natural physical authority without performance

default.description: well-cut dark suit or structured sport coat without tie, quality dress shirt collar open — expensive without announcing it. The clothes of a man whose wealth is infrastructure, not display
default.wardrobe_prompt: well-cut dark suit or structured sport coat, quality dress shirt open collar, no tie, no flashy accessories — expensive and understated

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: calm and measured — the face that gives away nothing it has not decided to give. When it softens, people feel they have earned something. That is the design
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 45-year-old Korean man, strong angular jaw with prominent age-sharpened cheekbones, dark sharp slightly hooded eyes with calm measuring gaze, thick dark brows with silver outer threading, strong straight broad-tip nose, medium neutral lips, dark hair with natural silver at temples cut short and clean, 178cm broad-shouldered solid relaxed-authority frame, warm medium lightly weathered Korean skin

style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black of rooms that rearrange around him before he speaks, warm amber of money and confidence as infrastructure and primary light, steel blue of the cold beneath every reasonable tone, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition, the gravity of a man who has not been wrong in a long time and may not notice when he finally is
negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark, young, smooth, idol look, flashy, aggressive expression, airbrushed
